title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file on src/prompts/spec.prompt
description: patch_file returned 'old_string not found' on src/prompts/spec.prompt when attempting to add the Reasoning Reviewer Persona section. The file uses Windows CRLF line endings; the patch old_string contained LF only. The operation was recovered by falling back to write_file with complete content, so the intended change was applied successfully.
proposed_resolution: Investigate why patch_file CRLF normalization (moeb.patch-file-crlf-normalize specification) did not strip CR characters from src/prompts/spec.prompt before exact-string matching. The normalization should cover prompt template files.
